summary: Radar for 2026-10-17, GLP-1 focus. I checked 9 candidates with web searches. The two strongest news hooks: (1) An EMA panel (CHMP) backed orforglipron (Foundayo) on Oct 16, 2026, and the European Commission still has to decide. That gives us a named pill with a question people already search: how is it different from the Wegovy pill? (2) Bloomberg reported on Oct 15 that FDA inspectors found black mold, insects and falsified records at two Chinese plants making semaglutide and tirzepatide ingredients for compounding. Both are now on FDA import alert. This fits our proven lane of calm warnings about unapproved products. Third: a Penn study used AI to read Reddit posts from people taking unapproved retatrutide. They mostly reported increased appetite, fatigue and a fast heart rate, while the trials were dominated by stomach side effects. That makes a good follow-up to our bootleg 'Reta' Short (165 views). Two evergreen tirzepatide lanes are still worth making: muscle and strength training, and the SURMOUNT-5 head-to-heads. A new 'Can tirzepatide…?' hook comes from a real-world study linking tirzepatide to lower rates of death and heart-failure flare-ups in type 2 diabetes with heart failure. The 'GLP-1 supplements' trend (Bon Appétit, new herbal products) is a good myth-buster. Novo's 2027 price cut came up again, but it was announced in Feb 2026, so it's old news and I left it out. Rejected: advice on switching from compounded semaglutide to tirzepatide, and GLP-1/anorexia telehealth content.

candidates.topic: Orforglipron (Foundayo) gets backing from an EMA panel (CHMP positive opinion, Oct 16, 2026): how is this GLP-1 pill different from the Wegovy pill?
candidates.angle: Plain-language Short: 'Orforglipron vs the Wegovy pill: what's actually different?' Orforglipron is a small-molecule pill that can be taken at any time of day without food or water rules (as Lilly and CNBC describe it). Oral semaglutide is a peptide pill with timing rules. Date the status: FDA-approved Apr 2026, UK MHRA approved Aug 10, 2026, CHMP positive opinion Oct 16, 2026, European Commission decision pending. Take weight-loss figures from ATTAIN-1, with its population (obesity without diabetes), the timeframe and the arm. Mention common stomach side effects. Add the prescriber line.
candidates.predicted_peak: 2–7 days (EC decision usually follows CHMP in about 67 days, which gives a second wave)
candidates.why_now: CHMP opinion on Oct 16, covered by CNBC, Bloomberg and Reuters syndication. Medscape's 'What to Know About the GLP-1 Pill Orforglipron' (Oct 16) and the Fierce oral GLP-1 tracker show pills are a hot search topic. Our semaglutide pill Short did well on both platforms (55 YouTube views, 52 IG reach).

evidence.signal: EMA panel backs Foundayo (orforglipron) for weight management and T2D; no food or water restrictions; up to 11% weight loss
Lilly's pill Foundayo gets EU nod for obesity and diabetes

candidates.topic: FDA finds black mold, insects and falsified records at two Chinese plants making semaglutide and tirzepatide ingredients for compounded GLP-1s (Bloomberg, Oct 15, 2026), now on FDA import alert
candidates.angle: Calm 'what's confirmed vs not' warning: what the FDA inspectors documented, what an import alert means, and why the ingredients in compounded products aren't FDA-reviewed the way approved medicines are. No company or seller names, nothing on how to buy. End with 'talk to your doctor or prescriber' about approved options. Title idea: 'Compounded tirzepatide and semaglutide: what FDA inspectors found'.
candidates.why_now: Bloomberg broke the story Oct 15. NewsNation, Yahoo and Quartz picked it up Oct 16, with Medscape ('branded users on compounded drugs') and MedShadow (sterility recalls) alongside. Our warnings about unapproved products are a proven lane (Reta 165, online retatrutide 58).

candidates.topic: Retatrutide side effects people report on Reddit vs the trials: a Penn AI study of 13,589 self-reported users of unapproved 'Reta'
candidates.angle: 'Why internet "Reta" isn't the trial drug.' The study classified posts from 13,589 Reddit users who said they were taking it. They most often reported increased appetite, fatigue, more energy, nausea, insomnia and a raised heart rate. The Phase 2 trial was dominated by stomach side effects. That gap is consistent with products not matching what they claim to be, but the study can't prove it. Pair this with poison-center exposures nearly doubling and the 2 death reports to FDA. Date the status: retatrutide is investigational as of Oct 2026. Check whether the paper is peer-reviewed or a medRxiv preprint before scripting.
candidates.why_now: EurekAlert release Oct 15 and a Medscape story Oct 15. Gizmodo, the AJC, Medical Daily (poison centers), Health and Me, and a Lilly lawsuit analysis all ran Oct 14–16. Search queries like 'retatrutide approval status' show up in the feeds. This continues our best Short.

evidence.signal: AI pulls side effects from Reddit posts by people taking unapproved retatrutide

candidates.topic: Tirzepatide vs semaglutide: which had more stomach side effects in SURMOUNT-5? (adults with obesity without diabetes, 72 weeks)
candidates.angle: Follow-up to our 109-view head-to-head. Name both drugs, put one number in the title, and answer within 10 s. Give the GI event rates per arm and the discontinuation rates, then 2 habits that may help with nausea (smaller meals, eating slowly). Add the prescriber line.
candidates.why_now: Comparison searches keep showing up in the feeds ('best weight loss drug 2026 tirzepatide vs semaglutide'), and the first head-to-head Short proved the format.

evidence.signal: Repeated 'tirzepatide vs semaglutide comparison 2026' query stories

Back it with the new Nutrients rapid review of protein plus resistance training (Oct 2), with the kidney caveat on protein.

candidates.why_now: Seen in 6 snapshots with momentum holding at about 80. The muscle Shorts got 130 and 98 views. A fresh review paper refreshes the hook.

candidates.topic: Do 'GLP-1 supplements' work like Ozempic or Mounjaro? New herbal 'GLP-1' products vs the prescription medicines
candidates.angle: Positive myth-buster. Supplements marketed as 'GLP-1' haven't been shown in trials to produce the weight loss seen with semaglutide or tirzepatide. Habits that support your body's own GLP-1 response (protein, fibre, eating vegetables and protein first) have modest effects and don't replace the medicine. Tie it to the Bon Appétit first-person piece. Never name supplement brands.
candidates.why_now: Bon Appétit (Oct 16), a new herbal 'GLP-1' product launch (Oct 16) and NutraIngredients on GLP-1-driven supplement demand show consumer interest is rising. That fits our 'natural ways to support your own GLP-1' pillar.

evidence.signal: 'I Tried GLP-1 Supplements for a Week. I'm Still Hungry.'

candidates.topic: Can tirzepatide help people with type 2 diabetes and heart failure? A real-world study links it to lower rates of death or heart-failure events (AJMC, Oct 15, 2026)
candidates.angle: Plain question title, at most 1 abbreviation, answered within 10–15 s. Keep the 'linked to' language because the study is observational. Give the population (T2D plus heart failure) and the comparator, and contrast with the randomized SUMMIT trial (HFpEF with obesity). Common side effects plus the prescriber line.
candidates.why_now: AJMC report Oct 15, plus a JCEM meta-analysis on tirzepatide in heart failure (Oct 13) and a Front Cardiovasc Med umbrella review. Our HFpEF Short got 52 IG reach. A plain title should do better on YouTube.
